arxiv-2110-14537.title: The contact process with fitness on Galton-Watson trees
arxiv-2110-14537.creator: Natalia Cardona-Tobón, Marcel Ortgiese
arxiv-2110-14537.description: Abstract The contact process is a simple model for the spread of an infection in a structured population. We consider a variant of this process on Bienaymé-Galton-Watson trees, where vertices are equipped with a random fitness representing inhomogeneous transmission rates among individuals. In this paper, we establish conditions under which this inhomogeneous contact process exhibits a phase transition.

arxiv-2111-07248.title: Background-Aware 3D Point Cloud Segmentation with Dynamic Point Feature Aggregation
arxiv-2111-07248.creator: Jiajing Chen, Burak Kakillioglu, and Senem Velipasalar
arxiv-2111-07248.description: Abstract With the proliferation of Lidar sensors and 3D vision cameras, 3D point cloud analysis has attracted significant attention in recent years. After the success of the pioneer work PointNet, deep learning-based methods have been increasingly applied to various tasks, including 3D point cloud segmentation and 3D object classification.

arxiv-2111-11324.title: A Time-Resolved Imaging System for the Diagnosis of X-ray Self-Emission in High Energy Density Physics Experiments
arxiv-2111-11324.creator: Jack W. D. Halliday, Simon N. Bland, Jack. D. Hare, Susan Parker, Lee G. Suttle, Danny R. Russell, Sergey V. Lebedev
arxiv-2111-11324.description: Abstract A diagnostic capable of recording spatially and temporally resolved X-ray self emission data was developed to characterise experiments on the MAGPIE pulsed-power generator. The diagnostic used two separate imaging systems: A pinhole imaging system with two dimensional spatial resolution and a slit imaging system with one dimensional spatial resolution. The two dimensional imaging system imaged light onto image plate.

arxiv-2203-16293.title: Core and stability notions in many-to-one matching markets with indifferences Thanks: We acknowledge financial support from UNSL through grants 032016 and 030320, from Consejo Nacional de Investigaciones Científicas y Técnicas (CONICET) through grant PIP 112-200801-00655, and from Agencia Nacional d
arxiv-2203-16293.creator: Agustín G. Bonifacio, Noelia Juarez, Pablo Neme, Jorge Oviedo
arxiv-2203-16293.description: Abstract In a many-to-one matching model with responsive preferences in which indifferences are allowed, we study three notions of core, three notions of stability, and their relationships. We show that (i) the core contains the stable set, (ii) the strong core coincides with the strongly stable set, and (iii) the super core coincides with the super stable set.

arxiv-2207-08661.title: Spectroscopy from Machine Learning by Accurately Representing the Atomic Polar Tensor
arxiv-2207-08661.creator: Philipp Schienbein
arxiv-2207-08661.description: Abstract Vibrational spectroscopy is a key technique to elucidate microscopic structure and dynamics. Without the aid of theoretical approaches, it is however, often difficult to understand such spectra at a microscopic level. Ab initio molecular dynamics have repeatedly proved to be suitable for this purpose, however, the computational cost can be daunting.

arxiv-2305-12081.title: MediTab : Scaling Medical Tabular Data Predictors via Data Consolidation, Enrichment, and Refinement
arxiv-2305-12081.creator: Zifeng Wang, Chufan Gao, Cao Xiao, Jimeng Sun
arxiv-2305-12081.description: Abstract Tabular data prediction has been employed in medical applications such as patient health risk prediction. However, existing methods usually revolve around the algorithm design while overlooking the significance of data engineering. Medical tabular datasets frequently exhibit significant heterogeneity across different sources, with limited sample sizes per source.

arxiv-2310-01810.title: High angular momentum coupling for enhanced Rydberg-atom sensing in the VHF band
arxiv-2310-01810.creator: Nikunjkumar Prajapati, Jakob W. Kunzler, Alexandra B. Artusio-Glimpse, Andrew Rotunno, Samuel Berweger, Matthew T. Simons, Christopher L. Holloway, Chad M. Gardner, Michael S. Mcbeth, Robert A. Younts
arxiv-2310-01810.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Nikunjkumar Prajapati, Jakob W. Kunzler, Alexandra B. Artusio-Glimpse, Andrew Rotunno, Samuel Berweger, Matthew T. Simons, Christopher L. Holloway, Chad M. Gardner, Michael S. Mcbeth, Robert A. Younts. Recent advances in Rydberg atom electrometry detail promising applications in radio frequency (RF) communications. Presently, most applications use carrier frequencies greater than 1 GHz where resonant Autler-Townes splitting provides the highest sensitivity.

arxiv-2310-09612.title: Deep Neural Networks Can Learn Generalizable Same-Different Visual Relations
arxiv-2310-09612.creator: Alexa R. Tartaglini, Sheridan Feucht, Michael A. Lepori, Wai Keen Vong, Charles Lovering Brenden M. Lake Ellie Pavlick
arxiv-2310-09612.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Alexa R. Tartaglini, Sheridan Feucht, Michael A. Lepori, Wai Keen Vong, Charles Lovering Brenden M. Lake Ellie Pavlick. Although deep neural networks can achieve human-level performance on many object recognition benchmarks, prior work suggests that these same models fail to learn simple abstract relations, such as determining whether two objects are the same or different . Much of this prior work focuses on training convolutional neural networks to classify images of two same or two different abstract shapes, testing generalization on within-distribution stimuli.

arxiv-2312-12225.title: Stochastic Ultralight Dark Matter Fluctuations in Pulsar Timing Arrays
arxiv-2312-12225.creator: Hyungjin Kim, Andrea Mitridate
arxiv-2312-12225.description: Abstract Metric perturbations induced by ultralight dark matter (ULDM) fields have long been identified as a potential target for pulsar timing array (PTA) observations. Previous works have focused on the coherent oscillation of metric perturbations at the characteristic frequency set by the ULDM mass.

arxiv-2404-00431.title: Visualizing Routes with AI-Discovered Street-View Patterns
arxiv-2404-00431.creator: Tsung Heng Wu, Md Amiruzzaman, Ye Zhao, Deepshikha Bhati, Jing Yang
arxiv-2404-00431.description: Abstract Street-level visual appearances play an important role in studying social systems, such as understanding the built environment, driving routes, and associated social and economic factors. It has not been integrated into a typical geographical visualization interface (e.g., map services) for planning driving routes. In this paper, we study this new visualization task with several new contributions.

arxiv-2404-17897.title: Tool Calling: Enhancing Medication Consultation via Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
arxiv-2404-17897.creator: Zhongzhen Huang, Kui Xue, Yongqi Fan, Linjie Mu, Ruoyu Liu, Tong Ruan, Shaoting Zhang, Xiaofan Zhang
arxiv-2404-17897.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zhongzhen Huang, Kui Xue, Yongqi Fan, Linjie Mu, Ruoyu Liu, Tong Ruan, Shaoting Zhang, Xiaofan Zhang. Large-scale language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success across various language tasks but suffer from hallucinations and temporal misalignment. To mitigate these shortcomings, Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has been utilized to provide external knowledge to facilitate the answer generation. However, applying such models to the medical domain faces several challenges due to the lack of domain-specific knowledge and the intricacy of real-world scenarios.

arxiv-2406-07245.title: A template for the arxiv style
arxiv-2406-07245.description: Abstract Diamond-like carbon thin films have emerged as durable, chemically stable optical coatings for many optical and optoelectronics applications due to their hardness, chemical inertness, and optical transparency. This paper presents a novel high-energy electron cyclotron resonance ion beam sputter deposition technique to fabricate pure diamond-like carbon coatings at room temperature.

arxiv-2502-05291.title: Can LLMs Rank the Harmfulness of Smaller LLMs? We are Not There Yet
arxiv-2502-05291.creator: Berk Atil, Vipul Gupta, Sarkar Snigdha Sarathi Das, Rebecca J. Passonneau, Penn State University, {bka5352, vkg5164, sfd5525, rjp49}@psu.edu
arxiv-2502-05291.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have become ubiquitous, thus it is important to understand their risks and limitations, such as their propensity to generate harmful output. This includes smaller LLMs, which are important for settings with constrained compute resources, such as edge devices. Detection of LLM harm typically requires human annotation, which is expensive to collect.

arxiv-2503-11138.title: The Case for ABI Interoperability in a Fault Tolerant MPI
arxiv-2503-11138.creator: Yao Xu, Grace Nansamba, Anthony Skjellum, Gene Cooperman
arxiv-2503-11138.description: Abstract There is new momentum behind an interoperable ABI for MPI, which will be a major component of MPI-5. This capability brings true separation of concerns to a running MPI computation. The linking and compilation of an MPI application becomes completely independent of the choice of MPI library. The MPI application is compiled once, and runs everywhere.

arxiv-2509-12177.title: A New Population of Point-like, Narrow-line Objects Revealed by the James Webb Space Telescope
arxiv-2509-12177.creator: Haojing Yan, Bangzheng Sun, Riley Shive
arxiv-2509-12177.description: Abstract We report a new population of objects discovered using the data from the James Webb Space Telescope, which are characterized by their point-like morphology and narrow permitted emission lines. Our sample includes nine objects found in three JWST wide survey fields, which have z = 3.624 z=3.624 to 5.378 and M B ≈ − 18.3 M_{B}\approx-18.3 to − 21.

pmc-10739368.title: ASSOCIATED FACTORS OF PARTICIPATION IN DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY: A STUDY BASED ON OLDER PEOPLE IN CHINA
pmc-10739368.creator: Lan Liu, Chao Guo, Liangshu Qi, Yingying Wang, Ruixin Shu
pmc-10739368.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). There has been an increasingly important trend that more and more older people take part in activities of digital technology nowadays in China. In this study, the research question associated to determinants of older people’s digital engagement was addressed, which has been quantitatively analyzed by statistical models in a sample of older people 60 to 98 years of age from China Longitudinal Aging Social Survey (N=11207).

pmc-11400962.title: A novel algorithmic multi-attribute decision-making framework for solar panel selection using modified aggregations of cubic intuitionistic fuzzy hypersoft set
pmc-11400962.creator: Muhammad Sajid, Khuram Ali Khan, Atiqe Ur Rahman, Sanaa A. Bajri, Alhanouf Alburaikan, Hamiden Abd El-Wahed Khalifa
pmc-11400962.description: To address the shortcomings of the cubic intuitionistic fuzzy sets (CIFSs) for the entitlement of multi-argument approximate function, the cubic intuitionistic fuzzy hypersoft set (Ω-set) is an emerging study area. This type of setting associates the sub-parametric tuples with the collection of CIFSs.

pmc-11433685.title: Angiotensin II—Real-Life Use and Literature Review
pmc-11433685.creator: Andreja Möller Petrun, Andrej Markota
pmc-11433685.description: Angiotensin II is a recently introduced vasopressor, which has been available since 2017. The novelty and the relatively high cost of angiotensin II currently limit its broader application. It induces vasoconstriction by activating the renin–angiotensin–aldosterone system and is currently the sole vasopressor functioning through this pathway. Beyond vasoconstriction, angiotensin II also affects various other physiological processes.

pmc-11476970.title: Perry Disease: Current Outlook and Advances in Drug Discovery Approach to Symptomatic Treatment
pmc-11476970.creator: Zbigniew Gajda, Magdalena Hawrylak, Jadwiga Handzlik, Kamil J. Kuder
pmc-11476970.description: Perry disease (PeD) is a rare, neurodegenerative, genetic disorder inherited in an autosomal dominant manner. The disease manifests as parkinsonism, with psychiatric symptoms on top, such as depression or sleep disorders, accompanied by unexpected weight loss, central hypoventilation, and aggregation of DNA-binding protein (TDP-43) in the brain. Due to the genetic cause, no causal treatment for PeD is currently available.

pmc-12440635.title: Inguinal Hernia Repair in a Centenarian
pmc-12440635.creator: Soniya Pateriya, Claudia Corbea, Joseph Russell, Todd Paul Mangione, Wilmer Mata
pmc-12440635.description: Centenarians present unique challenges regarding medical care, especially the decision to proceed with surgical intervention. This case report describes the successful surgical management of a 100-year-old man who presented to the emergency room with severe right lower abdominal pain due to a recurrent right inguinal hernia.

pmc-13245680.title: Isolated Rectal Neurofibroma in the Absence of Neurofibromatosis: Report and Review of Molecular Implications
pmc-13245680.creator: Karam Karam, Kim Charro, Ariane Alirkilicarslan, Aurélien Morini, Jacquot Rakotobe, Emilien Brousset, Christophe Locher
pmc-13245680.description: Neurofibromas are benign peripheral nerve sheath neoplasms composed of Schwann cells, fibroblasts, perineurial-like cells and axonal elements within a variably collagenous or myxoid stroma. They most commonly arise in the context of neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1), an autosomal dominant tumour predisposition syndrome driven by inactivating mutations of the NF1 tumour suppressor gene.

pmc-13272383.title: Microbial and host innate immune factors affecting the persistence of Staphylococcus aureus in cystic fibrosis airways
pmc-13272383.creator: Jacob D. Fairholm, Gavin Thomas Paul, Susan Birket, Balázs Rada
pmc-13272383.description: Chronic bacterial respiratory infections by Staphylococcus aureus are a hallmark of cystic fibrosis (CF) lung disease, affecting up to 80% of all people with CF by their mid-teens. S. aureus is able to survive and persist in the CF lung despite robust neutrophilic inflammation.

pmc-13500853.title: IMSI does not improve pregnancy outcomes and live birth rate in severe teratozoospermia patients: a double-blind randomized controlled trial
pmc-13500853.creator: Fatemeh Shakeri, Ali Nabi, Fatemeh Anbari, Saeideh Erfanian, Azam Agha-Rahimi

pmc-13573297.title: Smoking-Associated Enrichment of CXCL13+ Tfh Cells and VCAM1+ Fibroblasts Is Linked to Tertiary Lymphoid Structure Formation in Lung Adenocarcinoma
pmc-13573297.creator: Yong Jun Choi, Chi Young Kim, Eun Young Kim, Sang Hoon Lee, Min Kyung Park, Yoon Soo Chang
pmc-13573297.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundSmoking history is associated with improved immune checkpoint inhibitor treatment responses. We investigated smoking-associated differences in the tumor microenvironment (TME) of lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) and identified biomarkers associated with tertiary lymphoid structure (TLS) formation.MethodsSingle-cell RNA-sequencing datasets from tumors and matched adjacent normal tissues from five current smokers and five never-smokers with LUAD were integrated, and the T- and NK-cell compartments were analyzed in detail.

pmc-13652420.title: Perioperative considerations for total knee arthroplasty in a patient with situs inversus totalis: a case report
pmc-13652420.creator: Lei Xu, Qianheng Jin, Wen Ju, Lei Li, Ruixing Hou, Jihui Ju
pmc-13652420.description: Introduction:Situs inversus totalis is a rare congenital condition characterized by complete mirror-image transposition of the thoracic and abdominal organs. Although situs inversus totalis is commonly discussed in cardiothoracic and abdominal surgery, its implications for orthopedic procedures, such as total knee arthroplasty, remain poorly described.
